text:
Mr. Cook moved to accept the bid in an amount not to exceed $672,507.50, seconded by Mr.
Johnson. Motion carried by unanimous voicc vote.

Tom Cobb, City Engineer, provided a stalT report and Robin Loekman. City Treasurer, provided
additional information. Chairwoman Aldrich commented on the item.

There being no further items for the agenda to come before the Finance Committee, the meeting
was adjourned at 12:16 p.m.


Submitted by,


lennifer McClelland
Executive Assistant to the City Council
